name: Contracted carry-forward
expected: ContactedPricing branch fires for IsContracted=true line; PricingDate seeded from EffectiveDate; after PricingContractId removed, line re-routes to catalog path and PricingDate resets (no stale carryover).
actual: ContactedPricing branch cannot fire: org-wide re-verify shows 1 QLI with PricingContractId set (0QLWC000003kk694AA, quote 0Q0WC000003FaZJ0A0) and 0 OrderItems. That QLI references Draft contract 800WC00000SFn6jYAD. After force-reprice through V21, IsContracted=null on both contracted L1 and catalog L2; both route the catalog path at identical Net=1575, Source_List_Price=1575, Base_Price=1575. The ContactedPricing filter (IsContracted IsNotNull AND IsContracted=true AND PricingDate IsNull) never evaluates to true because the Platform derives IsContracted from the Contracted Pricing feature, which requires an Activated Contract; the only contract in org is Draft. Additionally, PricingDate is not a persisted field on QLI/OI, so no stale-date carryover between reprices is architecturally possible regardless of the contracted branch state.
evidence: Force-reprice isSuccess=true on Quote 0Q0WC000003FaZJ0A0 (https://fortra--uat.sandbox.lightning.force.com/lightning/r/Quote/0Q0WC000003FaZJ0A0/view). SOQL: SELECT COUNT(Id) FROM QuoteLineItem WHERE PricingContractId!=null => 1 (QLI 0QLWC000003kk694AA); SELECT COUNT(Id) FROM OrderItem WHERE PricingContractId!=null => 0. Contract 800WC00000SFn6jYAD Status=Draft. Post-reprice QLI query: L1(contracted) Net=1575 Source_List_Price=1575 Base_Price=1575; L2(catalog) Net=1575 Source_List_Price=1575 Base_Price=1575 -- identical, both on catalog path. Fresh V21 retrieve 2026-06-30: ContactedPricing filter lines 1508-1538 unchanged (IsContracted IsNotNull AND IsContracted=true AND PricingDate IsNull); PricingDate is context-only not a persisted QLI column (confirmed via REST describe on 0QLWC000003kk694AA). Context definition SalesTransactionContextExt_v2 (Jun 29 retrieve): IsContracted inherited from SalesTransactionContext__stdctx/version/QuoteEntitiesMapping/SalesTransactionItem/IsContracted -- platform-managed, not simply PricingContractId!=null.
notes: 2026-06-30 run3 re-measure. Verdict unchanged from run1 BLOCKED. New evidence vs run1: (1) found and force-repriced the one contracted QLI in the org (D-06 fixture artifact); confirmed ContactedPricing branch did not fire -- L1 and L2 priced identically on catalog path. (2) Fresh V21 retrieve confirms ContactedPricing filter is unchanged. (3) Architecture confirmed: PricingDate is not a persisted QLI field (no stale-carryover risk). (4) ContractItemPrice object exists (1 record: 1AuWC000002G4050AC, price=111, discount=10%, on Draft contract) but the Activated-Contract precondition is not met. Smoke-testing the source-switch toggle requires: Activated contract + matching ContractItemPrice with active date range on a product + QLI referencing the contract + force-reprice to confirm IsContracted=true routing. This constitutes a TEST-DATA-ARTIFACT blocker (not a V21 defect) because the feature is wired in V21 but the Contracted Pricing feature is not operationally enabled in FortraUAT (Draft contract only). Would need UAT admin action to activate contract before this scenario can be smoke-tested.
verdict_reason: BLOCKED: preflight fails because IsContracted is never true in this org (only contracted QLI has PricingContractId referencing a Draft contract; platform does not set IsContracted=true from a Draft contract). Force-reprice on the one available contracted QLI confirmed the ContactedPricing branch did not fire -- both contracted and catalog lines price identically through the catalog waterfall. PricingDate is not a persisted field so the stale-carryover concern is architecturally moot. Contracted Pricing feature is not operationally configured in FortraUAT.
